steps.en: Install the skill into Claude Code, Codex or another skills-aware agent (Node 18+)
steps.zh: 把技能装进 Claude Code、Codex 等助手（需 Node 18+）

steps.en: Ask the agent to open the library instead of naming a move you cannot name
steps.zh: 叫不出动作名时，直接让助手打开图库

steps.en: Opens the moving-sample gallery and waits on a one-time local listener
steps.zh: 打开动态样例图库，本机一次性监听等待

steps.en: Press Pick on the samples you want, add a note, press Send to AI
steps.zh: 给想要的样例点 Pick，写备注，再点 Send to AI

steps.en: Tell the agent what to do with the picks in your project
steps.zh: 告诉助手这些选择用在项目哪里
steps.code: Edit the opening of this video like this.

steps.en: Fetches the spec and reference code for exactly those numbers and their pack kits
steps.zh: 只取这几个编号的规格、参考代码和配套 kit

steps.en: Rebuilds each move in your stack with the published timings, then lists what it used
steps.zh: 按原定时长和缓动在你的技术栈重建，并列出所用编号

value.en: Point at a move you saw instead of describing it, and get its exact timings ported
value.zh: 看见就能指名，不用再费力描述动作，原样的时长和缓动直接搬进项目
